raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Shared the lead, weakened over the concluding stages, finished off only fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 並排領先。末段轉弱。衝刺僅屬一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on under pressure, snatched third on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持走勢。過終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, improved between rivals to challenge 150m out, stayed on and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。在對手之間上前，一百五十米處展開挑戰。保持走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, looking to improve when short of room 300m out to 200m out, unable to quicken once clear, lost ground final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處至二百米處之間在空位不足下嘗試推進，但望空後未能加速。最後五十米失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W2W) Tracked pace, three wide, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, commenced move after passing 500M, 1-1/2L back turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly, lost two places towards finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，局中間之前位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後開始上前。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。走勢平穩。接近終點時失去兩位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Wide in mid-field, under pressure 500m out, soon lost place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。五百米處受催策。瞬即失位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W5W) Mid-field, raced wide, forced wider final bend, soon lost place and well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎被迫走更外疊。瞬即失位，所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W4W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, crowded top of the Straight, gave ground thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W4W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路初受擠迫，其後墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W3W5W) Sat handy, angled out rounding the Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W3W5W) 居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) In touch with leaders, ridden to hold position from halfway, soon weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自半程起受催策以保持位置。直路上瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W4W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 3 wide with no cover behind midfield, moved closer after passing 900M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過九百米處後追近。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat towards rear, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Not hurried on jumping from draw 1, settled in second half of the field, ran on only fairly in the straight. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘，未受催策，居後半馬群中。直路上走勢僅屬一般。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 given a patient ride in a rearward spot, had some work to do top of the straight, lacked a turn of foot and couldn't launch a serious challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。直路初仍落後甚遠。未能加速以展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Settled well behind and waited with, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, produced strong late finish between runners inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 遙居於後，留力候上。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後二百米在馬匹之間衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, steadied near 800M, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。接近八百米處時收慢。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Pushed along to be racing closely behind leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M, weakened towards the finish. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受推策，緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百五十米處時後勁不繼。末段轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead to turn, peaked and headed 200M, stayed on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前輕鬆領放。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Chased leader after jumping from draw 13, briefly led early straight but soon couldn't keep up with pursuing rivals, faded to finish 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔躍出後追趕領放馬。直路早段一度領先，但瞬即未能抗衡緊追的對手。力竭，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon led from a poor draw, gradually shifted across for rails run over 1200M out, led until joined early in home straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即領放。千二米處逐漸切入內欄。領先至直路初被追及。最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, ridden over 200m out, closed down final 100m, headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處受催策。最後一百米被追近。過終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kept on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, minor progress made when asked (See incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置。在催策下略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, wide into home straight, kept going but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Sat just behind the leaders, travelled nicely at the top of the Straight, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路初走勢良佳，在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield, traveled reasonably well, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢不俗。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Stumbled leaving stalls then squeezed out, good headway up inside rail over 300m out, unable to sustain and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時失蹄，其後受擠迫。三百米處沿欄追前甚多。最後一百米後繼無力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield early, dropped to midfield after entering the back straight, 3 wide after passing 900M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後墮居中間位置。跑過九百米處後走第三疊。轉入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, hung out in the home turn, one pace when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路彎外閃。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield early, dropped towards rear 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, closed off well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。六百米處墮居後列。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W) Jumped awkwardly, held up, last entering home straight, passed a few under pressure late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W) 出閘笨拙，留後。入直路時居包尾位置。末段在催策下超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Average to begin, raced in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out after passing 700M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過七百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Away with them, raced in midfield on the inside, peaked on turn, weakened gradually in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎未能再增速。直路上逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, not much response when asked, no contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。對催策無甚反應。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride near last 8-9Ls off the pace, had big task in hand top of straight, failed to respond and finished tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置，留力候上，落後領放馬八至九個馬位。直路初落後甚遠。末段對催策毫無反應，大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, had to wait for run briefly entering home straight headway between horses, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。入直路時一度須等待空位出現，在馬匹之間追前。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Raced behind midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, unable to quicken under pressure 300m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處在催策下未能增速。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat at the back 3 wide, never in contention.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W1W1W) Three wide in rear without cover, dropped to last place 900m out, under pressure 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W1W1W) 居後列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。九百米處墮居包尾位置。五百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W5W) Sat rear, raced wide throughout, hung out badly, no contention (See Incident Report, Unacceptable racing manners and performance, Must trial around a bend).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W5W) 居後列，沿途走外疊。嚴重外閃。未能參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。走勢及表現均難以接受。必須在轉彎途程上試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat outside the lead, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居領放馬外側。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, ridden and lost ground final bend, hung left, little impression after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。受催策，直路彎失地。外閃，其後無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W3W) Sat handy 3 wide no cover, only one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。受催策，但僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W2W2W2W) Wide early, chased leader, under pressure 400m out, remained in challenging position until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W2W2W2W) 早段走外疊，追趕領放馬。四百米處受催策。持續展開挑戰，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on okay, weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 受催策上前帶頭。保持不俗走勢。最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked pace, ridden and made effort 400m out, no extra and lost ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。受催策，四百米處發力。最後二百米再無餘力，失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, slightly improved after passing 600M, 2nd turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過六百米處後略為推進。入直路時居第二位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, headed 250M, kept on well until approaching 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。二百五十米處被超越，保持佳勢直至趨近五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, challenged the leader 600M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。六百米處挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, failed to respond under whip (See Incident Report).
(Blood at the right nostril.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。對鞭策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右邊鼻孔有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled midfield, one pace to the finish (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Towards rear, pushed along final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。直路彎受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W2W1W1W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 800m out, forced to steady 200m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W2W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處受催策。二百米處被迫收慢。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Held up last from wide draw, late headway into mid-division, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。末段追前至中間位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W1W1W) Sat rear, not much response when asked, no contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W1W1W) 居後列。對催策反應不大。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Always in last few on rail, saved ground turning in for home, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿途居最後數位之內，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away and lost four lengths, always well in rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，落後四個馬位。全程遙居於後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W2W3W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 1100M, slightly improved in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。千一米處向外移出，中段略為推進。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W2W4W) Crowded and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 450m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W2W4W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。四百五十米處向外移出推進。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, 7 lengths back turning in, difficult to obtain clear run early in straight, made some headway thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走內疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路早段難以望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced slightly better than midfield on outer, no cover throughout, 3 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat in front of midfield, weakened passing 250M, gave ground quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱，迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, hung out in the Home Straight, failed to run out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路上外閃，未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, bumped near 600M, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時發生碰撞。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out and made contact near 450M, no clear run until approaching final 100M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。接近四百五十米處時向外移出及發生觸碰。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat on pace, weakened slightly passing the 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列。跑過二百五十米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield early, dropped to midfield near 800M, 5 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近八百米處時墮居中間位置。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W4W) Waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, some late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受催策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped at start, tracked leaders, pushed along 500m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, made late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out approaching 350M, closed off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Settled in midfield, came under pressure onto home bend, one of the widest into straight, ran on to assert authority close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。開始轉直路彎時受催策。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。追前，接近終點時控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Began moderately settling towards rear, kept on one pace without quickening from a similar position into home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列。入直路時保持同速，未能自相若位置加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Started well from wide draw but soon taken back to race in rear, stayed on well down the outside final 200m and passed several rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留居後列。最後二百米保持佳勢，走外疊，超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, good headway final bend, sustained headway to challenge 200m out, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前甚多。持續推進，二百米處展開挑戰。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Prominent 3-wide without cover in early stages, obtained cover in 2L 5th over 1000M out, slightly further off the speed rounding home bend and 6th into straight, fought on under pressure inside final 200M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處居第五位，落後兩個馬位，有遮擋。轉直路彎時略為落後領放馬更遠。入直路時居第六位。最後二百米在催策下力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, peaked and headed approaching 300M, weakened and eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。趨近三百米處時未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, raced keenly, unable to pick up from pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，搶口。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, 1/4L back turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (4W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(4W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。一百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced outside of leader, unable to quicken with that rival 300m out, stuck to task, stayed on closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。三百米處未能與領放馬一同加速。末段在力拼下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield but trapped wide early, sent forward after passing 700M, took the lead 600M, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後受催策上前。六百米處取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Travelled wide throughout after beginning from a wide barrier, improved steadily from towards rear to reach 2L 4th in back straight 800M out, drifted wider into straight and soon weakened out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後沿途走外疊。自後列穩步上前，八百米處在對面直路上進佔第四位，落後兩個馬位。入直路時移出較外疊。瞬即轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (4W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, kept on nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(4W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。保持佳勢，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in midfield on outer, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, ran on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W4W) Began well from gate 11, trapped wide in midfield, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W4W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, showed some dash, run peaked final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。略為加速上前。最後七十五米未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Across to track leader, ridden along to chase leader 600m out, stayed on steadily but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 切入以跟隨領放馬。六百米處受催策，追趕領放馬。保持穩勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W2W) Ridden from the widest draw settling one back in 2nd 850M out, improved to take up running 440M out holding over 1L advantage into straight, kept on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策。八百五十米處居第二位，落後一個馬位。上前，四百四十米處取得領先。入直路時領先逾一個馬位。末段在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W) Tracked clear leader, gave chase from 400m out, overhauled that rival 100m out, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W) 跟隨遙遙領先的領放馬。自四百米處起追趕領放馬。一百米處超越該駒。走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Mid-field, under pressure 300m out, stayed on final 150m, couldn't quite reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處受催策。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began smartly, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside early, dropped to midfield in the middle stages, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Ridden to the front briefly before taken over 2L back to 3rd 900M out, became 4th some 4L back 600M out, kept on early in straight before swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 受催策，一度帶頭，其後留後逾兩個馬位，九百米處居第三位。六百米處居第四位，落後約四個馬位。直路初保持同速。最後一百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Sat outside the lead 2 wide, one pace when asked. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。未能望空直至二百米處，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W1W) Mustered pace and worked to cross and lead, toughened it out well only overhauled by first two final stages, improved effort.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W1W) 在催策下加速以切入領放。以佳勢力拼，僅於末段被首兩名馬匹超越。表現有進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W1W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off without threatening. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W1W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段展開衝刺，但未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Close up early, gradually drifted 3L back to 4th when tempo increased in back straight, gained 3rd from a tiring runner onto home bend and fought on steadily in home straight, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。對面直路上步速加快時逐漸墮居第四位，落後三個馬位。開始轉直路彎時超越一匹漸呈疲態的對手，進佔第三位。直路上持續力拼。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Mid-field, checked briefly 500m out, one paced under pressure and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處一度勒避。在催策下保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Settled towards rear on the rail, saved ground in the turn, made some ground in the final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。最後一百五十米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat 2 wide outside to the leader, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走第二疊。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Bumped heavily at start and unbalanced, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, same margin back turning in, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 起步時發生大力碰撞，因而失去平衡。落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。入直路時落後相同距離。衝刺良佳，取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Raced in rear after checked 1100m out, under pressure from 700m out to hold position, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 千一米處勒避，其後居後列。自七百米處起受催策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, bumped 1000m out, under pressure on bend to chase leaders, left behind home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。一千米處發生碰撞。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。直路上被拋離，所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Taken back from the outside barrier, sat towards the rear on the rail, made minor headway late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 800m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處一度受阻礙。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Led early, headed after 500m, remained prominent, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 早段領放。跑了五百米後被超越。保持居前列。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced 3-wide in midfield, struggled to keep up 600M, soon beaten turning home. (Jockey - may not have appreciated racing on AWT / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處難以跟上對手。轉直路彎時瞬即洩氣。（騎師表示，坐騎或未能適應在全天候跑道上作賽。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W5W) Shifted in and lost balance at start, tracked pace out wide without cover, hampered 400m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W5W) 起步時向內斜跑及失去平衡，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受阻礙。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead turning into home straight, headed by winner and weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。轉入直路時率先加速，取得領先。接近終點時被頭馬超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure to challenge leader 400m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, took the early lead, headed 950M, 2nd in the middle stages, hard ridden from 200M, retook the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段取得領先。九百五十米處被超越，中段居第二位。自二百米處起受力策，一百五十米處再次取得領先。保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W1W1W) Involved in early battle for lead, led outright after 450m, responded to pressure from 300m out, challenged 100m out, winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑了四百五十米後單騎領放。自三百米處起對催策交出反應。一百米處受挑戰。未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 6 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped moderately from the wideset barrier and soon taken well back, commenced move inside the 600M racing 3-wide rounding home bend, obtained a clear run just inside the 200M, ran on well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘普通，瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。六百米處開始上前，轉直路彎時走第三疊。跑過二百米處後望空。以佳勢追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped start, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' side, hard ridden from 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時與對手互相碰撞，落後領放馬兩個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。自三百米處起受力策。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at tail, 8 lengths back turning in, made good progress until no clear run in the closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個馬位。追前甚多，直至末段未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mustered no early speed and settled last, made up some steady ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段缺乏前速，居尾列。在催策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In rear after awkward start, dropped to last place 600m out, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。六百米處墮後至包尾位置。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, mid division, ridden along to maintain position halfway out, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置。半程時受催策以保持位置。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in second half of the field, 7Ls to make up 400M but failed to finish off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後半馬群中。四百米處落後七個馬位，但末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Lacked early pace, ridden to soon recover to 7th some 6L back on rail in back straight, tightened and lost a stride 500M out, ran home one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 缺乏前速。受催策，瞬即恢復走勢。對面直路上居第七位，落後約六個馬位，走內欄。五百米處受緊迫，失去步韻。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Lacked pace early and soon dropped to rear despite ridden early, remained well behind into straight, saved ground home turn, produced good late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 早段欠缺前速，儘管受催策，但瞬即墮居後列。入直路時仍落後甚遠。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, taken wide in straight and made minor progress. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear 2 wide, steadied at the early stages, started to make progress rounding Home Turn, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。早段收慢。轉直路彎時開始推進。以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken across from wide draw, raced towards rear, stayed on at the one pace under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後切入內疊，居後列。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W3W4W) Keen towards rear, forward move out wide into mid-field at halfway, headway 300m out, shifted left briefly 200m out, stayed on well, every chance final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W3W4W) 居後列，搶口。半程時上前至中間位置，走外疊。三百米處追前。二百米處一度向外斜跑。末段保持佳勢，最後五十米已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, found rail 900M, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。九百米處移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide approaching 500M, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近五百米處時走第二疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, dropped out from wide draw, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，墮後。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Shifted out at the start and was slowest into stride, recovered to race in midfield, closed off final 300M evenly but never able to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，展步最慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。最後三百米以穩勢衝刺，但從未能挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Chased leaders, raced keenly in the early stages, driven along nearing 400M but soon couldn't keep up with leaders. Out of contention mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹。早段搶口。接近四百米處時受催策，但瞬即未能跟上領先馬匹。直路中段再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W2W) Bumped out of stalls, chased leader, ridden to press leader 500m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追趕領放馬。五百米處受催策，追迫領放馬。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Gradually took up running obtaining rails run 1300M out, led the field until headed 150M out, kept on for a place at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 逐漸取得領先，千三米處移入內欄。持續領先，直至一百五十米處被超越。保持走勢，過終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2-1/2L back turning in, showed good response in straight, hit the front 200M, kept on strongly to the line, won by 3 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳。二百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，以三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked the leader, raced keenly in the early stages, gave ground passing 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。早段搶口。跑過二百米處時墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W2W) Wide early, improved to chase leader after 600m, unable to match that rival home straight but stuck on to hold second, edged right.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W2W) 早段走外疊。過了六百米處後上前追趕領放馬。直路上不敵該對手，持續力拼，保持居第二位。末段向內斜跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards midfield 2 wide, angled out in the home turn, raced tight in the straight, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居接近中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎向外移出，直路上緊迫競跑。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Made contact at start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 起步時被觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Took up running on rail over 1300M out, increased tempo early in back straight kicking over 2.5L clear, came back to the field rounding home bend, folded up quickly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 千三米處取得領先，走內欄。對面直路初加速帶離逾兩個半馬位。轉直路彎時被馬群追上。直路上迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, unable to improve position, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。未能追前。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped on jumping, driven forward to hold a position ahead of midfield, ran home one paced, soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，受催策上前，居中間之前位置。末段保持同速，瞬即再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留後。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly and unbalanced, raced 2 wide towards rear, a bit closer on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，失去平衡，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W3W) Held up, good headway from 200m out, stayed on, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W3W) 留後。自二百米處起追前甚多。末段保持走勢，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, was severely checked in the middle stages, made some steady ground final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。中段大力勒避。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Sat last on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, ran on nicely once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。直路早段受困，望空後以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Sat towards rear, improved from 400M, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。自四百米處起推進。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Niggled along in rear of midfield in 7th on rail, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, baulked for a run from inside the 200M and could make no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策，居中間之後第七位，走內欄。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處起受困。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W5W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, swung wide in the straight, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路上移出外疊，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Sat towards the rear, unable to quickened. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居後列。未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(+) (4W2W2W) Settled worse than midfield, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
(Jockey dropped right rein at 250M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(+)(4W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。走勢尚可。末段穩步追前。
（於二百五十米處騎師右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W2W) Sat behind midfield, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W2W) 居中間之後位置。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, traveled okay at midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般。居中間位置，走內欄，走勢尚可。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, effort 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢及被碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處發力。其後在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 3 wide with no cover, 2 lengths or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰，落後約兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Moderately away, positioned 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 750M, raced 3 wide, a length or so back on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。七百五十米處開始上前，走第三疊。直路彎落後約一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W4W) In touch with leaders, wide into home straight, strong run to challenge leader 100m out, got on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處向領放馬展開挑戰。最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, showed dash top of the Straight, one pace final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初加速上前。最後一百五十米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Towards rear, niggled along a fair way out, gradual headway from 400m out, stayed on into second final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 居後列，落後頗遠，受催策。自四百米處起逐漸上前。最後五十米保持走勢，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield, 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back turning in, kept on evenly in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, under pressure to challenge over 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處在催策下展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-division, headway halfway as leading trio came back to field, improved to lead 150m out, headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。半程時上前，追及被馬群追上的領先三駒。推進，一百五十米處取得領先。過終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-3/4L turning in, kept on very well in straight, easily scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，從容獲勝。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat at the rear, hung in and never seriously tested. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。內閃。從未能真正施為。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Dropped in from wide draw, raced in last pair, pushed along final bend, stayed on late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，向內移入，居最後兩位。直路彎受推策。末段保持走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Sat worse than midfield, improved passing the 700M, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。跑過七百米處時上前。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持強勁走勢，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) In rear after impeded leaving stalls, dropped to last place 500m out, ran on strongly final 200m to pass plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後居後列。五百米處墮居包尾位置。最後二百米以勁勢追前，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sent forward to be prominent 3 wide, kept on only fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。末段僅能保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped well from gate 12, raced prominently on the outside, slightly taken back after passing 1200M, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。跑過千二米處後稍為留後，走第二疊。中段落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly and then checked briefly, in rear, very wide and pushed along turning into home straight, no response.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W5W) 出閘笨拙，其後一度勒避，居後列，走大外疊。轉入直路時受推策，毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, checked briefly and blundered 400m out, unable to quicken for pressure, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處一度勒避及失蹄。在催策下未能加速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Keen in mid-field, rail position, unable to quicken 300m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 中段搶口，走內欄。三百米處未能加速，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W1W1W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, held up, keen under restraint, forward move 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W1W1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞。受困，在約束下搶口。三百米處上前，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield the fence, failed to respond given a few reminders over final stages, eased down last 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段數度受鞭策，毫無反應，最後一百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, gave ground passing the 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 居前列，走勢一般。跑過一百五十米處時墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders, tried to challenge up rail from 450m up, unable to pick up for pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自四百五十米處起嘗試展開挑戰，走內欄。直路上受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide throughout in mid-field, one paced under pressure, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊。在催策下保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made no ground
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Waited with, clear run up rail and good headway from top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 留力候上。自直路初起沿欄望空，追前甚多。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stayed on steadily but no threat to front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。保持穩勢，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Mid-field, wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W1W1W) Sent forward from wide draw to lead, headed 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前領放。二百米處被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W3W) Raced wide from high draw, started well but soon eased back, lost place and last 400m out, left behind from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即收慢留後，走外疊。四百米處失位，居包尾位置，其後被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, switched out at the Turn, failed to respond in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎向外移出。直路上對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Rear of mid-field, no response to pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處對催策毫無反應，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W5W) Sat near the rear, never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W5W) 居接近包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Moderately away from a tricky draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, peaked 500M, weakened thereafter.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自第九檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。五百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, made minor ground on the inside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段在內疊略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Bumped start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield, lay in in the Home Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置。直路上內閃。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat behind the lead, traveled strongly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走勢強勁。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, hard ridden from 400M, struck the running rail 300m becoming unbalanced, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 75M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前，取得領先。直路彎前走勢良佳。自四百米處起受力策。三百米處踢中內欄，失去平衡。保持佳勢，但最後七十五米未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W2W4W) Waited with in rear, under pressure 600m out, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。六百米處受催策。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Held up in last pair, outpaced early in home straight, late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 留居最後兩位之內。直路初被拋離。末段追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W2W) Commenced well, positioned 3-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 650M, same margin back turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬三個半馬位，走內疊。自六百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上移出外疊，末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Sat towards the rear, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居後列。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, driven top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄居中間之後位置。直路初受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Dropped back from draw 1 to race in midfield, had over 4Ls to make up 400M but couldn't muster the speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘後墮居中間位置。四百米處落後逾四個馬位。末段未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 450M, 8 to 9 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後八至九個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, shuffled back after halfway, angled wide over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。半程後墮後。二百米處移出外疊。保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Settled rear, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢不俗。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Waited with, under pressure in rear turning into home straight, strong run on wide outside final 150m, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 留力候上。轉入直路時居後列，受催策。最後一百五十米在外疊走勢強勁。接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, under pressure from the 450M, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。自四百五十米處起受催策。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, ran on well final 200m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in rear of midfield, in similar position into straight, ran home one-paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時位置相若。在催策下保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat handy, slightly weakened passing the 200M, closed off okay (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W5W) From draw 13 unable to slot in, raced 3-wide without cover in midfield throughout, couldn't keep up with rivals passing 250M, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W5W) 自第十三檔出閘後未能切入，沿途居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過二百五十米處時未能跟上對手，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced at tail, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘稍慢，被碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in the second half of the field on the rail throughout, failed to make any impression in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後半馬群中。沿途走內欄。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat last, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W1W2W1W) Tracked leader, made effort and in share of lead turning into home straight, no extra and faded final 150m.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W1W2W1W) 跟隨領放馬。轉入直路時發力上前，並排領先。最後一百五十米再無餘力及力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) From draw 3 settled down in midfield along the inside, couldn't go on turning into straight, weakened rapidly to finish tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。轉入直路時無以為繼。其後迅速轉弱，包尾大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Gradually settled at the back from a wide barrier, detached from over 500M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留居後列。自五百米處起被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W1W) Settled in mid-field, keen early stages, ridden to hold position 900m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間位置。早段搶口。九百米處受催策以保持位置。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Reserved in mid-division 5Ls off the pace before keeping on steadily over final 300M to take 4th. (Jockey fined for returning to scale 2 lbs overweight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 留居中間位置，落後領放馬五個馬位。最後三百米保持穩勢，取得第四名。（騎師因返回覆磅時超磅兩磅而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W1W) Gradually settled in midfield, drifted further back when tempo increased 800M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W1W) 逐漸居中間位置。八百米處步速加快時進一步墮退。從未能收復失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Settled just over 2L back in 4th, quickened under pressure 300M out reaching 2nd but over 3L off the leader and eventual winner just over 200M out, lost the quinella spot late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位。三百米處在催策下加速，就在二百米處進佔第二位，但落後領放馬兼頭馬逾三個馬位。末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, had to wait for run from top of home straight until 300m out, effort to chase leaders until no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自直路早段起須等待空位出現直至三百米處。在催策下追趕領先馬匹，最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Away in line , stayed close to leaders throughout, worked into the race well, moved up and vied for lead passing 300M, couldn't keep up with first two late but held 3rd comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，沿途保持緊隨領先馬匹。走勢良佳，跑過三百米處時上前爭奪領先。末段未能跟上首兩名馬匹，但從容取得季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, a bit closer on turn, hit the front 200M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。二百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, wider turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, held up at the top of the Straight, not much response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置。直路初受困。對催策反應不大。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Tracked leader, driven 350m out and slightly outpaced, stayed on well and improved to hold every chance final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百五十米處受催策，但略被拋離。保持佳勢，最後一百米上前，已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure 700m out to chase leader, one paced under pressure, flattened out close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。七百米處受催策以追趕領放馬。在催策下保持同速。接近終點時洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Wide early, disputed lead, still every chance 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 早段走外疊，爭奪領先。一百米處仍甚具爭勝機會，但末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W3W) Began swiftly and tracked pace, unable to slot in and face the breeze throughout, momentarily struck the front 150m out and boxed on solidly, despite a tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬。未能切入內疊，沿途沒有遮擋。一百五十米處一度取得領先，儘管耗力甚多，仍持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind the leaders, switched out in the Straight, ran on nicely, run peaked at the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。直路上向外移出。以佳勢上前。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began fairly gradually improved to 5th some 3L back on rail, angled out for a run entering home straight, obtained a clear run 250M out but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，逐漸推進至第五位，落後約三個馬位，走內欄。進入直路時向外移出取位。二百五十米處望空，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Ridden along from wide draw to track leaders, switched wide 600m out to avoid a rival that was giving ground, ridden along to chase leaders on bend, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處移出外疊避開一匹正在墮退的對手。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders, under pressure from halfway to hold position, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。自半程起受催策以保持位置。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-field, wide throughout, stayed on final 200m, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。沿途走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 400m out, ran on well final 200m, closed on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米保持佳勢。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, in rear, forced to steady on heels 500m out, made up some late ground.
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，居後列。五百米處被迫收慢避開對手的後蹄。末段略為追前。
（異常呼吸狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Waited with in rear, switched wide 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處移出外疊，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Mid-field, rail position throughout, unable to quicken for pressure 200m out, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，沿途走內欄。二百米處在催策下未能加速。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 150M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。趨近一百五十米處時望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leader, unable to keep tabs on that rival from 300m out, stuck to task to hold second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起未能跟上領放馬。持續力拼，保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, inconvenienced near 900M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, not enough room early in straight, cleared 150M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時受妨礙。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路初空位不足，一百五十米處望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, moved closer on turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well to the line, just able to hold off the challenger late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點。末段僅能力拒對手挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead final 50m, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 8 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置，落後約八個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W4W4W) Held up in rear, taken wide final bend, stayed on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W4W4W) 留居後列。直路彎移出外疊。最後二百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Keen in mid-field, angled wide to make effort 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 中段搶口。三百米處移出外疊以發力，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat midfield, switched out rounding the Turn, minor progress made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, driven along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Moderately away, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, kept on well to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空。保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, pressed on passing 500M, switched out, responded reasonably well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居包尾位置。跑過五百米處時受催策。其後向外移出，在催策下反應不俗。
