runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W) Sat midfield 3 wide early, got into 2 wide spot rounding the Home Turn, short of room top of the Straight, closed off reasonably well despite the inference.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時移入第二疊。直路初空位不足。儘管受干擾，但末段衝刺頗佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, angled off rail and chased leaders into home straight, responded to pressure to lead closing stages, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時移離內欄，追趕領先馬匹。末段對催策交出反應，取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly to 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。五百米處前走勢暢順。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 3 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, raced on outside of field, no impression under pressure, dropped away final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，走外欄。在催策下毫無表現。最後一百五十米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide behind the leader, challenged the leader in the early straight, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟前競跑，居領放馬之後，走第二疊。直路早段挑戰領放馬。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) From draw 4 raced just behind leaders throughout, wide no cover from 800M, weakened under pressure shortly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自第四檔出閘，沿途居領先馬匹稍後位置。自八百米處起走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路後不久在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped at the start, dropped back to race towards the rear 5Ls off the pace, made some inroads towards the finish but failed to seriously threaten at any stage.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時發生碰撞，墮居後列，落後領放馬五個馬位。末段略為追前，但從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, struggled to hold position from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起難以保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Maintained a position in midfield, came under pressure home turn and dropped away on straightening. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受催策。入直路時墮退。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (6W3W3W) Began well from gate 10, trapped very wide in midfield early, moved a bit closer after passing 850M, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(6W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速。早段居中間位置，走大外疊。跑過八百五十米處後略為追近。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W2W2W) Sent forward to be racing outside the lead, struggled to keep up 350M, gave ground rapidly mid-straight. (Jockey - racing wide without cover the principal reason for its disappointing run.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W2W2W) 受催策上前，居領放馬外側。三百五十米處難以跟上對手。直路中段迅速墮退。（騎師表示，坐騎在沒有遮擋下走外疊是表現令人失望的主因。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bounced away awkwardly and checked when bumped, made some headway from the tail of the field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，在被碰撞之際勒避。末段自馬群尾列略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Travelled very wide without cover in rear of midfield, yielded ground rounding home bend, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時墮退。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Prominent, took up running over 800M out setting a sound pace, held narrow lead until headed about 250M out, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，八百米處帶頭，以快步速領放。以短距離領先，直至二百五十米處被超越。迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, towards the rear 6Ls back, failed to run on in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，落後六個馬位。直路上未能上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start along the rail to share early pace, crossed by race leaders and lost position 600M out, some 3L back in 4th rounding home bend, faded steadily in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，早段跟上步速，走內欄。六百米處被領先馬匹橫越，失位。轉直路彎時居第四位，落後約三個馬位。直路上逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slow away and crowded at the start, switched to the middle part of track 300M out, stayed on fairly well inside final 200M, went third towards finish (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，受擠迫。三百米處移至跑道中央。最後二百米保持不俗走勢。趨近終點時跑入季席。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Challenged for the lead 3 wide, kept on nicely to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先，走第三疊。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Out in line, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to lead, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。保持佳勢，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 2-3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。轉入直路時領先二又四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never travelled. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。沿途走勢欠順。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Not far off early stages gradually drifting backward to midfield over 700M out, folded up quickly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W2W2W) 早段落後領先馬匹不遠。七百米處逐漸墮居中間位置。入直路後迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Raced close up, pushed up to challenge leader 150m out, bumped with that rival when shifting right final 100m, edged ahead near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。一百五十米處受推策上前挑戰領放馬。最後一百米在向內斜跑之際與該駒互相碰撞。接近終點時取得領先，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leader on rail, baulked for a run until the 300M after straightening, quickened to hold every chance only to be overshadowed final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。入直路後受困直至三百米處。加速，一度極具爭勝機會，僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide, 1-1/2L back, 2 wide from 700M, same margin back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後一個半馬位，走第三疊。自七百米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, responded when challenged from over 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。自三百米處起受挑戰，交出反應。一百五十米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led on the rail, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Performance unacceptable, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿欄領先。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受，必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。保持走勢直至最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed on entering home straight, closed down final 100m, headed late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭。進入直路時受催策。最後一百米被追近。末段被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced prominently, 2 wide, a length or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped nicely and led, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。保持佳勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Star Turn from Spotty Socks, a daughter of Pluck. Horses by the same sire include Storming Dragon and Cirrus Speed. The fellow was given six trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second under slight pressure, beaten by 3/4L, over 800m on turf in Conghua on May 18. In the latest trial, he made the run and finished third under pressure, beaten by 1-1/2Ls, over 1000m on turf at Happy Valley on September 19. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「演藝焦點」(Star Turn)之後，在港同父馬包括「勇霸龍」及「萬里雲」等駒，生母出自Pluck。抵港後六次試閘兩次上名。5月18日出試從化草地800米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近9月19日出試谷草1000米，早段領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.5個馬位。初出有一爭之力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Ridden along in the early stages to be one out one back, stuck on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段受催策，居第二疊第二位。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Disputed lead between horses, nothing extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在馬匹之間爭奪領先。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, took the lead 950M, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。九百五十米處取得領先，入直路時領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, kept on to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。保持走勢，保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Average to begin, raced better than midfield, nearer to the middle track, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘普通。居中間之前位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W) Bumped start, took the early lead, headed and made contact near 900M, 2nd on turn, hard ridden after passing 350M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，早段領放。接近九百米處時被超越及與對手互相觸碰。直路彎居第二位，跑過三百五十米處後受力策，但反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held up last, still in rear travelling smoothly 300m out, short of room when trying to improve 200m out, finished off strongly through horses, eye-catcher.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Recovered from sluggish start to race in mid-field against rail, some headway 300m out, soon unable to sustain, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，恢復走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處略為追前，瞬即無以為繼 。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Pushed to a forward position just outside leader, struggled to keep up entering home straight, weakened away badly to finish last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 受推策佔取前列位置，在領放馬外側競跑。入直路時難以跟上對手。嚴重轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat last, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat just behind the leaders 2 wide, weakened and gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置，走第二疊。直路上轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, showed no response in straight, eased final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 出閘僅屬一般及發生觸碰，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上對催策毫無反應。最後一百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led from pole position, headed final 100M, unable to find an extra gear when being challenged.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自最內檔出閘後領放。最後一百米被超越。受挑戰時未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Raced 3 wide no cover, kept on only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 走第三疊，沒有遮擋。僅能保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, checked briefly halfway and unable to hold position, left behind in rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。半程時一度勒避，未能保持位置。最後二百米被拋離，居後列過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderate start, recovered swiftly between runners to take up running over 950M out setting a smart pace on home bend, led until tiring 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後在馬匹之間迅速恢復走勢，九百五十米處取得領先。直路彎以快步速領放。保持領先直至三百米處呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped on terms and settled 3rd towards the middle part of the track, responded only fairly when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居第三位，在跑道中央競跑。對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L at 400M, peaked and headed 150M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，受催策上前領先。四百米處領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Raced wide without cover, better than midfield, after beginning from a wide barrier, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後居中間之前位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide behind midfield, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Niggled along in forward of midfield on rail, steadied up in slackened tempo rounding home bend, baulked behind runners after straightening, quickened well inside final 150M to just get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 受催策，居中間之前位置，走內欄。轉直路彎步速減慢時收慢。入直路後在馬匹之後受困。最後一百五十米加速良佳。終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made minor ground. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Began well, restrained to race in midfield 3Ls back, couldn't accelerate enough passing halfway. Never a threat to leaders.
(Lost left front plate.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置，落後三個馬位。跑過半程時加速力不足。從未能威脅領先馬匹。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, three wide in mid-field with cover, hung right in home straight and switched 150m out, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W3W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路上內閃。一百五十米處轉換跑線。末段走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, raced very wide without cover throughout, widest into home straight, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走最外疊。二百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Dropped back to last on jumping from wide draw, saved ground on the inside but still had plenty to do 400M, failed to run on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。走內疊節省腳程，但四百米處仍落後甚遠。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Settled behind midfield 3 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield, 3 wide, 5 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leader, no extra and lost ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。最後一百五十米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged up rail from 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W3W) Sat last, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Sat last, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 居尾列。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, ridden to hold position from 400m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起在催策下保持位置。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Towards rear, stayed on inside rail, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，固守內欄。受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Crowded in rear of midfield on first bend dropping to last few, remained in similar rear position near the rail entering home straight, made modest progress behind runners.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，受擠迫。轉首個彎位時墮居最後數位之內。入直路時仍居相若的後列位置，靠近內欄競跑。在馬群之後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled towards the rear, not much luck in running, never fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，陣上取位欠順。從未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat behind midfield, traveled okay, responded reasonably well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢尚可。在鞭策下反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Held up last after slowly away, rail position throughout, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。沿途走內欄。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide towards rear, hampered near 700M, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) 3-wide in midfield early stages, taken back towards rear in 8th into back straight, hung in and unbalanced causing interferences 500M out, kept on same pace from 7th into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。入對面直路時留居後列第八位。五百米處內閃及失去平衡，造成干擾。入直路時居第七位，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Average to begin, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W) Sent forward from wide draw, across to lead outright after 500m, headed over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前。跑了五百米後切入單騎領放。二百米處被超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Pressed leader three wide, starting to weaken when badly hampered 250m out, soon no chance.
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 追迫領放馬，走第三疊。二百五十米處受嚴重阻礙時開始轉弱。瞬即失去爭勝機會。
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) 3L back in 6th on rails most of the way, shifted out for a run upon straightening reaching 2L 3rd briefly 150M out, weakened noticeably inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 大部分途程居第六位，落後三個馬位，走內欄。入直路時向外移出取位。一百五十米處一度進佔第三位，落後兩個馬位。最後一百米顯著轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Commenced well, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well until approaching 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持佳勢直至趨近一百米處，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Sat handy, switched out rounding the Turn, made good ground under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。在鞭策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Bumped exiting stalls, raced very wide throughout without cover, driven 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W4W) Shifted out at start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, driven along top of home straight, no headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Bumped start and unbalanced, sent forward to race prominently, allowed rival to cross near 550M, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞及失去平衡，受催策上前，居前列。接近五百五十米處時讓對手過頭。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初在催策下反應平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Outpaced towards rear of mid-field from halfway, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自半程起被拋離，居中間之後位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never involved. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear, 2 away from the stands' rail, switched to the middle track after passing 400M, no clear run until approaching 150M, finished off strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外欄第三疊。跑過四百米處後移至跑道中央。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled midfield, trapped wide throughout, crowded near the 750M, unable to sustain his run final 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊。接近七百五十米處時受擠迫。最後二百米後勁不繼。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, took the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Started fast but unable to hold position, checked and back into mid-field halfway, one paced under pressure, checked briefly 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，但未能保持位置。半程時勒避，墮居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。二百米處一度勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, similar position on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, closed off nicely until checked at the 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。衝刺良佳，五十米處勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, sat handy, switched out rounding the Turn, made some ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Sat towards rear, improved rounding the Turn, responded nicely when asked, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時推進。對催策反應良佳。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, peaked and headed 400M, weakened thereafter.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。四百米處未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat handy, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走勢尚可。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Ridden along and outpaced early stages, wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。入直路時走外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, driven along bend, unable to quicken, stayed on final 100m, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受催策，未能加速。最後一百米保持走勢，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Sat towards rear, traveled fairly well, made steady ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居後列，走勢不俗。直路上以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat behind midfield, lay out at the Straight, proved difficult to ride out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置。直路上外閃。難以被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Mid-field, opened up for him against rail early in home straight, chased winner from 200m out, never looked like reaching that rival.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置。直路早段沿欄望空。自二百米處起追趕頭馬，從未看似能追及對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 2 wide, 1 to 2 lengths back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，落後一至兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, stayed on final 200m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Raced wide in mid-field, some headway under pressure 200m out, flattening out when hampered 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。二百米處在催策下略為追前。五十米處受阻礙之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Settled in worse than midfield, in similar position into home straight, briefly baulked over 200M out, ran home one-paced without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時居相若位置。二百米處一度受困。末段保持同速，未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, no extra and lost ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。最後一百五十米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier and soon taken back to last few, became last on straightening despite saving ground on rail, soon detached.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，瞬即留居最後數位之內。入直路時雖走內欄節省腳程，但居包尾位置。瞬即被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W) Taken back from wide draw, last and pushed along into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W) 自外檔出閘後留後。入直路時居包尾位置，受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Held up last, ridden along middle stages to catch up to main body, eased once well held in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。中段受催策以追上主馬群。直路上遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind the leader on the inside, peaked on turn, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居領放馬之後，走內疊。直路彎未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，入直路時走勢暢順。走勢良佳，最後五十米取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W) Out with rest, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, closed off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made contact with the gate on jumping, sat rear, made some ground from behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂，居後列。末段自後列略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上略為追前。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in midfield, left flat footed when the race got serious from 400M. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。自四百米處起馬群加速時停滯不前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W) Raced 3-wide without cover just better than midfield, weakened out of contention inside final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W) 居中間稍前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百五十米轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled at the rear on the rail, 2 wide in the turn, made good ground from the back in last 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。直路彎走第二疊。最後一百五十米自後列追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W3W3W) From wide draw obtained a midfield position along the 3-path, ran on mildly over final 300M for 3rd. Not reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後居中間位置，走第三疊。最後三百米走勢普通，跑入季席。未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; In 5th on settling, came under pressure 500M, soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居第五位。五百米處受催策。其後瞬即再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 550M, angled out 400M, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。自五百五十米處起走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。直路初追前頗多。一百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W1W) Always thereabouts, obtained rails run just inside the 800M and cover in 3rd 650M out, did not find much room until switched out for a run 150M out, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W1W) 沿途居前列。就在八百米處移入內欄，六百五十米處居第三位，有遮擋。空位不足，一百五十米處移出外疊取位。穩步上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Tracked leaders, bumped 1000m out, ridden along 650m out to chase leaders, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一千米處發生碰撞。六百五十米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, crowded 600m out, ridden along 250m out, ran on well but no match for winner, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫。二百五十米處受催策。走勢強勁，但未能抗衡頭馬，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W1W2W) Began well enough, eased back to sit in mid-division 6Ls back, picked up strongly passing 300M, ran on determinedly and got past leader close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W1W2W) 出閘頗佳，收慢留居中間位置，落後六個馬位。跑過三百米處時加速強勁。末段以勁勢上前，接近終點時超越領放馬，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Caught racing wide no cover behind midfield, brought wide for home then closed off strongly to be beaten a head by the long time leader.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時移至外疊，其後以勁勢衝刺，以一馬頭位之差不敵領先了一段長途程的領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven 400m out to chase leaders, not best of runs early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路早段未能完全望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W4W) Stumbled shortly after the start, failed to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position, ended up in midfield 4-5Ls away, closed off one paced in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W4W) 起步後不久失蹄，未能展現足夠前速以佔取更為靠前位置，居中間位置，落後四至五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced in midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden along 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke well, gradually settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced without quickening under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，逐漸居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Driven along after the start but failed to show sufficient pace going forward, ended up racing behind mid-division, couldn't make up ground in the straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步後受催策，但未能展現足夠前速上前，居中間之後位置。直路上未能追前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, stayed on strongly, in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。保持勁勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) From draw 1 moved up to chase leaders, steadied 350M then closed off nicely to hit lead inside 100M, ran away late to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前追趕領先馬匹。三百五十米處收慢，其後衝刺良佳，一百米處取得領先。末段帶離對手，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along early stages and settled in rail position of mid-field, struggled to hold position from 600m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，居中間位置，走內欄。自六百米處起難以保持位置。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Away fast and led 1L on settling, headed soon after straightening then weakened rapidly to finish last. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，領先一個馬位。入直路後瞬即被超越，其後迅速轉弱，包尾而回。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Slow to begin, settled behind midfield further back than intended, fought on steadily in the straight but couldn't quicken enough to get past leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居較賽前部署為後的中間之後位置。直路上持續力拼，但加速力不足以超越領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, under pressure 250m out, stayed on well, tired closing stages and just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。二百五十米處受催策。保持佳勢。末段呈現疲態，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Driven to take up running from a poor draw, obtained rails run in front early in back straight, led until headed under pressure over 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下取得領先。對面直路初移入內欄領放。保持領先，五十米處在催策下被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Flew from the machine from barrier 6 and led, put 3 lengths turning in, kept travelling on straightening up and scored by 2-3/4L impressively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第六檔出閘迅速，領放。入直路時保持走勢，領先三個馬位。以二又四分三個馬位之先掄元，表現悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W) Checked shortly after start, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, hung in 300m out, ran on strongly final 100m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W) 起步後不久勒避，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。三百米處內閃。最後一百米以勁勢追前。僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, had to wait for run turning into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 300M, kept on well until approaching 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空，三百米處望空。保持佳勢直至趨近五十米處，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tended to hang right in home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路上傾向內閃。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Soon took up running holding narrow advantage, went some 1L clear upon straightening and hung on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 瞬即領放，以短距離領先。入直路時帶離約一個馬位，保持走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, hung right under pressure home straight, no extra final 150m.
(Blood at both nostrils but no blood in trachea so was deemed not to have bled.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Blood at both nostrils but no blood in trachea so was deemed not to have bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路上在催策下內閃。最後一百五十米再無餘力。
（兩邊鼻孔有血，但氣管沒有血，故不被視為流鼻血。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （兩邊鼻孔有血，但氣管沒有血，故不被視為流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) In touch with leaders, good headway on bend into share of lead, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路彎追前甚多，並排領先。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W2W) Lost considerable ground at start, soon recovered to rear of the field while racing keenly 1000M out, tight behind runners on rail inside the 600M, switched for a run over 200M out producing good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W2W) 起步時失地甚多。瞬即恢復走勢，居後列，一千米處搶口。六百米處在馬群之後受緊迫，走內欄。二百米處轉換跑線取位，末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W4W) Sat ahead of midfield just over 2Ls off leader, brought wide from 400M, loomed up and fought hard, briefly in front 150M but run ended passing 100M and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。自四百米處起移出外疊。其後在力拼下上前。一百五十米處一度取得領先，但跑過一百米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, tracked leaders, travelled strongly final bend to lead top of home straight, stayed on, headed by front three close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎走勢強勁，直路初取得領先。保持走勢，接近終點時被三甲馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden to take up running 950M out and rails run 800M out, kicked some 2L clear in front rounding home bend, just held off strong challenges in straight to prevail narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策，九百五十米處取得領先，八百米處移入內欄。轉直路彎時加速帶離約兩個馬位。直路上力拒對手的強勁挑戰，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Caught racing wide in midfield, hung in throughout and responded only fairly in the straight. (Jockey fined for failing to ride out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。沿途內閃，直路上對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點，表現未能令小組滿意而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Held a position behind midfield, swung wide into straight for his challenge but made limited progress only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰，但僅能略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in mid-division, had difficulty obtaining clear running 300M-100M, kept on without threat to first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處至一百米處之間難以望空。末段保持走勢，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to switch 500m out, clear run 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處未能轉換跑線。二百米處望空，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上，早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, no clear run in the Straight, never tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路上未能望空。從未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, held up and never tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段受困。從未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away, rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, eased when detached 200m out.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。二百米處被拋離時收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Awkward start, settled in mid-field, short of room early in home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。直路早段空位不足。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from draw 1, vied for early lead before easing back to track leaders, driven to challenge for the lead again early straight, proved no match for first two passing 200M, lost 3rd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段爭奪領先，其後收慢以跟隨領先馬匹。直路初在催策下再度爭奪領先。跑過二百米處時不敵首兩名馬匹。接近終點時失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, taken wider 600m out, driven along 400m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處被帶出較外疊。四百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, dropped to rear turning into home straight, switched inside early in home straight, bumped 150m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時墮居後列。直路早段移入內疊。一百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Positively ridden out the gate and obtained a leading position as expected, pressed by rival throughout the race, couldn't sustain run final 150m and gave ground late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘後受積極催策，一如預期取得領先。沿途受對手追迫。最後一百五十米後繼無力。末段墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made running, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 50m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭競跑。直路初加速。五十米處被頭馬超越。僅能保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Crowded after the start, pushed forward to track leader on outside, briefly took over early straight, run ended 150M from home and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 起步後受擠迫，受推策上前，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初一度領先。一百五十米處無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Soon in front, pressed by rival in the lead, headed nearing 200M before fading final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，領先時受對手追迫。接近二百米處時被超越。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden along 450m out, strong run to lead close home, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, ran on ordinarily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。走勢普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Raced in touch, clear run up inside rail from top of home straight, good headway to lead under 100m out, comfortably on top closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自直路初起沿內欄望空。以佳勢追前，一百米處取得領先。末段輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden along halfway to hold position, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。半程時受催策以保持位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Rear of mid-field, a bit outpaced 350m out, warmed to task and staying on when running out of room behind leaders final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。三百五十米處被略為拋離。加速上前，最後五十米在領先馬匹之後空位不足時保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Quickly into stride, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, wide into home straight, bumped 150m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊。一百五十米處發生碰撞。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide better than midfield, similar position on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Sustained a laceration to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a laceration to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（右後腿割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, settled behind midfield, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙。居中間之後位置。末段穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W) Settled mainly towards rear in 8th travelling keenly at times, shifted wide for a run into home straight, ran on well down the centre of the track to snatch 2nd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W) 大多居後列第八位，不時搶口。入直路時移出外疊以取位。沿跑道中央以佳勢上前，末段取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 自最外檔出閘時發生碰撞，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W4W) Unable to slot in from wide draw, caught wide in midfield and left without cover from 600M, ran home well enough final 300M to be beaten 1.5L at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，未能切入內疊，居中間位置，走外疊。自六百米處起沒有遮擋。最後三百米衝刺良佳，過終點時以一個半馬位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Chased leaders in 3rd, fought hard to stay in contention on straightening, couldn't keep up with leaders final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，居第三位。入直路時力拼以保持爭逐機會。最後一百五十米未能跟上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Caught wide no cover early stages, strode forward to settle outside the lead, in 3rd spot making home turn but didn't have much left in tank on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，沒有遮擋。展步上前居領放馬外側。轉直路彎時居第三位，入直路時無甚餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Shifted out at start, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Made contact at start, positioned 3 wide in midfield, travelled keenly in the early and middle stages, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊。早段及中段搶口。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Sat in front of midfield 3 wide, run peak at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Away only fairly from the middle of the line, recovered to be midfield one off, held up briefly at the home turn, travelled to the line ok (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自中檔出閘僅屬一般，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎一度受困。末段走勢尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W3W3W) Settled in rear 3-wide from the widest barrier, commenced move and wider rounding home bend, finished off the race well inside final 150M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，居後列，走第三疊。轉直路彎時開始上前，走更外疊。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, caught in a pocket behind front two against rail when trying to challenge 150m out, switched 100m out, ran on well and still closing at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一百五十米處嘗試沿欄展開挑戰時在頭兩名馬匹之後坐包廂。一百米處轉換跑線。末段以佳勢追前，過終點時仍持續追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught racing 3-wide without cover towards the tail of the field, couldn't muster the pace to challenge on straightening. (Jockey fined for failing to ride out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居尾列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時未能加速以展開挑戰。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點，表現未能令小組滿意而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced keenly in the early and middle stages and refused to settle, couldn't quicken enough in the straight, no extra final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般。早段及中段搶口，不願穩定走勢。直路上加速不足。最後二百米再無餘力。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, closed off without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段以勁勢衝刺，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in last few on rail from the widest barrier, saved ground in a similar position into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，居相若位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, headway out wide on bend, stayed on and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前，走外疊。保持走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Tracked leaders, dropped to mid-field 800m out, moved smoothly into contention 400m out, stayed on but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。八百米處墮居中間位置。四百米處順勢上前挑戰。保持走勢，但不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Heavily bumped and lost balance out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, short of room top of home straight, followed winner through 200m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時被大力碰撞，嚴重失去平衡。居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初空位不足。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Rear of mid-field, wide into home straight, headway onto heels of leaders 200m out, run flattened out when a bit tight for room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時走外疊。二百米處上前緊隨領先馬匹，末段在略受緊迫之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Began well from the widest draw, trapped wide in midfield, no cover throughout, a bit closer turning in, finished off strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時略為追近。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, improving from the 500M, stayed on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間之後位置。自五百米處起推進。末段保持勁勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Not hurried and raced in second half of the field throughout in a fast run race, urged along 450M, picked up well to challenge for the lead mid-straight but no match for winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 留力候上，沿途在快步速下居後半馬群中。四百五十米處受催策。加速良佳，直路中段爭奪領先，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back, same position on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began fairly gradually settling in 4th mainly about 3L off the pace, came to challenge inside the 350M reaching 2L 2nd briefly inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，逐漸居第四位，大多落後領放馬約三個馬位。三百五十米處上前展開挑戰。二百米處一度進佔第二位，落後兩個馬位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, briefly hampered 1600m out, shuffled back mid-race, wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。千六米處一度受阻礙。中段墮後。入直路時走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W5W) Settled well behind and waited with, commenced move approaching final turn to be one of the widest into home straight, made significant progress to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 遙居於後，留力候上。趨近直路彎時開始上前。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Raced in rear of mid-field, not best of runs 400m out to 100m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。四百米處至一百米處之間取位不太暢順。其後保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W1W1W) Pressed leader, improved to lead 1100m out, joined 500m out, headed 250m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W1W1W) 追迫領放馬。推進上前，千一米處取得領先。五百米處被追上。二百五十米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) From wide draw failed to show sufficient pace to go forward despite being ridden along, taken back to the rear 5-6Ls off the pace, swung wide for home and didn't finish off. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，雖然受催策，但未能展現足夠前速上前。留居後列，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。入直路時移出外疊，衝刺乏力。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden to 5th along rail within 2L of pace, improved steadily to lead or disputed from 900M out, unable to sustain effort inside final 300M and folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 在催策下居第五位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走內欄。自九百米處起穩步上前以帶頭或爭奪領先。最後三百米後繼無力，迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sluggish start, ridden along to press leader, struggled to hold position turning into home straight, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘緩慢，在催策下追迫領放馬。轉入直路時難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, hampered near the 200M, had every chance (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢暢順。接近二百米處時受阻礙。已獲機會盡展所長。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Out wide in rear of mid-field early stages, commenced move 1400m out to join the lead 900m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段居中間之後位置，走外疊。千四米處開始上前。九百米處追上領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat outside lead, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居領放馬外側。保持勁勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Shifted in and crowded at start, settled in mid-field, under pressure 700m out, stayed on well but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，受擠迫，居中間位置。七百米處受催策。末段保持佳勢，但不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Pressed along to be chasing leaders, couldn't quicken with rivals passing 300M, no extra late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 受催策以追趕領先馬匹。跑過三百米處時未能與對手一起加速，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, switched wide 550m out, bumped 350m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。五百五十米處移出外疊。三百五十米處發生碰撞。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, ridden 250m out, strong run to lead final 50m, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。二百五十米處受催策。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Shared lead early stages before settling down in 3rd, couldn't find extra gear to challenge leaders and was comfortably held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段並排領先，其後居第三位。未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹，始終未能追近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, challenged leaders early in home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初挑戰領先馬匹。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Well there from a middle draw before taken one back 2-wide, held up in 3rd just off the pace before drifting further away from pace 500M out, gradually faded in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自中檔出閘，居好位，其後留後一個馬位，走第二疊。留居領放馬稍後的第三位。五百米處落後領放馬更遠。直路上逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。趨近一百米處時未能再增速，被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, two lengths clear into home straight, headed by winner 200m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。入直路時領先兩個馬位。二百米處被頭馬超越，最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 200m out, no match for winner, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。二百米處被頭馬超越。未能與頭馬抗衡，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began well to make all obtaining rails run over 1000M out, held over 1L advantage most of way before ridden clear 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。一千米處移入內欄。大部分途程領先逾一個馬位，三百米處在催策下帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running after beginning from the one draw attempting to make all, defied serious challenge after straightening to re-gain advantage 150M out only to be denied close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後瞬即領放，嘗試一放到底。入直路後力拒對手的強勁挑戰，一百五十米處再次拉開與對手的距離。僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Raced wide without cover, chased along early, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 走外疊，沒有遮擋，早段追趕對手。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Soon emerged as leader and allowed to set steady pace to the straight, showed good response under pressure, challenged by rivals over final 250M but was always holding on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，直路前以平穩步速領放。對催策反應良佳。最後二百五十米受挑戰，但一直力拒對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W3W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier before shifting back to behind midfield some 7L off the pace in back straight, renewed effort 3-wide rounding home bend and wider into straight, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。對面直路上留居中間之後位置，落後領放馬約七個馬位。轉直路彎時重新發力，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。走勢平穩，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Bumped and unbalanced shortly after start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
(Lame in right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞及失去平衡，居第二位，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。末段保持穩勢。
（右後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W2W2W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W2W2W4W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, found rail near 950M, shared lead on turn, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百五十米處時移入內欄。直路彎並排領先。直路初未能再增速，被超越。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the early lead, headed near 1250M, 2nd in the middle stages, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘普通，早段受催策上前領放。接近一千二百五十米處時被超越。中段居第二位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W3W) Awkward start and lost ground, driven along and outpaced early stages, detached middle stages, eased when detached 500m out.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地。早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。中段被拋離。五百米處被拋離之際收慢。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) Across to press leader, pushed along to challenge leader 450m out, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。四百五十米處受推策以挑戰領放馬。走勢強勁，一百五十米處帶頭，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled handy, made steady progress over the final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居前列。最後一百五十米穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out 550M, showed limited response after turning in, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處向外移出。入直路後對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Went forward and chased leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, hampered near 300M, couldn't keep up with leaders passing the 150M, weakened away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 上前追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。接近三百米處時受阻礙。跑過一百五十米處時未能跟上領先馬匹，其後轉弱墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced at rear on the inside, last turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Stuck to inside rail throughout, mid-field, clear run in home straight, stayed on to edge ahead final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，沿途固守內欄。直路上望空。保持走勢，最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and made heavy contact, raced better than midfield on rail, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, bumped 200M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相大力觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。二百米處發生碰撞。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Reserved in midfield along the fence 3-4Ls back, in similar position turning home, ran on well final 300M, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 沿欄留居中間位置，落後三至四個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置。最後三百米以佳勢上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace out wide, improved to press leader 900m out, ridden 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。上前，九百米處追迫領放馬。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, dropped to rear into home straight, some late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時墮居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Prominent from a middle barrier before settling one back in 3rd on rail, came to challenge into home straight holding every chance but unable to sustain effort inside final 120M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第七檔出閘後居前列，其後居第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。入直路時展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後一百二十米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢暢順。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled not far off in joint 4th 3-wide without cover, kept on in home straight until finding no extra inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 落後領先馬匹不遠，並列第四位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上保持走勢，直至最後三百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W6W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear throughout, never a factor. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W6W) 自外檔出閘後留後。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) In touch with leaders, keen, shuffled back to mid-field final bend, wide into home straight, good headway to lead 200m out, stayed on but winner too strong final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 跟隨領先馬匹，搶口。直路彎墮居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。以佳勢上前，二百米處取得領先。保持走勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Sat last, stayed on without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 居包尾位置。保持走勢，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Crowded at start settling well back 3-wide with cover, switched and obtained a clear passage 300M out, finished off the race well. (Tactic questioned)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時受擠迫，遙居於後，走第三疊，有遮擋。三百米處轉換跑線及望空。末段以佳勢衝刺。（騎師被查詢騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Up with early pace before easing back to race ahead of mid-division, kept on at the same pace final 300M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段與領放馬並跑，繼而留居中間之前位置。最後三百米保持同速，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Sat handy, traveled smoothly, made good ground under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居前列，走勢暢順。在鞭策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W2W) Sent forward from wide draw and raced outside of leader, in share of lead from 400m out, every chance until no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，居領放馬外側。自四百米處起並排領先。一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) In touch with leaders early, drifted back into mid-field back straight, when also checked briefly, stayed on under pressure final 300m, moved into third 75m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹。對面直路上墮居中間位置，一度勒避。最後三百米在催策下保持走勢。七十五米處進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced 4 wide no cover midfield, under pressure from the 600M, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起受催策。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Recovered steadily on rail to 3L 6th about 1200M out after moderate start, drifted 5L back in midfield rounding home bend, one-paced under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後逐漸恢復走勢，約千二米處居第六位，落後三個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時墮後五個馬位，居中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on same pace until approaching 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。保持同速直至趨近一百五十米處，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Bumped heavily at start, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生大力碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, disputed led, clear leader top of home straight, headed by winner 250m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，爭奪領先。直路初領放。二百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along widest into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped at the start, from draw 11 moved up to track leader, all out final 400M but was readily held by the winner who was 4 runs unbeaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔起步時發生碰撞，上前跟隨領放馬。最後四百米全力以赴，但一直落後四戰全勝的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W) Pressed forward from a poor draw settling 1L back 3-wide in back straight, kept on from a similar position into home straight before dropping out tamely 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。對面直路上落後一個馬位，走第三疊。入直路時自相若位置保持走勢。一百米處乏力墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 150m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現前速以切入領放。直路初加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。其後保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, held up and never able to be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段受困，從未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Impeded leaving stalls, held up last, had to wait for run turning into home straight, twice short of room when trying to improve in home straight, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時受阻，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路上在嘗試推進之際兩度空位不足。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) From draw 3 dropped back to race near last, kept to inside throughout, closed off quite well to go 2nd close home without troubling the winner. (Jockey fined for returning 3 lbs overweight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，墮後至接近包尾位置。沿途走內疊。末段衝刺頗佳，接近終點時進佔第二位，但未能威脅頭馬。（騎師因返回覆磅時超磅三磅而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。未能望空直至一百米處。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed no early pace and settled to be the last few on the rail, briefly held up in the last 100M, travelled strongly to the line, did not disgrace at all.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 欠缺前速，居最後數位之內，走內欄。最後一百米一度受困。以勁勢衝刺至終點。表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, driven 400m out to chase leaders, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, some headway on bend, clear run 150m out, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路彎略為追前。一百五十米處望空，以勁勢上前。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Dropped back from a wide draw, held up in last 6-7Ls off the pace, picked up nicely in the straight and made nice inroads under top weight 135lb to take 3rd just before line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。直路上加速良佳，在負頂磅一百三十五磅下追前甚多，過終點前跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in rear, driven along 400m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。四百米處受催策。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W1W) From wide draw taken back to last and was given a waiting ride, 8Ls behind leader 400M, closed off fastest under top weight but couldn't be ridden out final 50M when held up between rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，早段未受催策。四百米處落後領放馬八個馬位。在負頂磅下末段衝刺最快，但最後五十米在對手之間受困時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Restrained to race towards the rear, 4-5Ls off leader 400M, closed off fastest to claim 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 受約束，居後列。四百米處落後領放馬四至五個馬位。末段衝刺最快，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 400m out, ran on well to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處開始發力，走外疊。以佳勢追近領放馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W) Obtained a midfield spot along the inside, held up 300M-200M before quickening up strongly to win by dominant margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內疊。三百米處至二百米處之間受困，其後加速強勁，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, obtained a 2-wide position midfield, had every chance turning home but couldn't quicken enough final 200M to challenge for a top three finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後二百米加速不足，未能挑戰三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Caught racing wide behind leaders and had no cover in the middle stages, driven to challenge for the lead 400M, began to weaken 150M, checked 100M losing momentum. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。四百米處在催策下爭奪領先。一百五十米處開始轉弱。一百米處勒避，失去步韻。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled out to make run 500m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處向外移出取位。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (5W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly to make up a lot of ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。以勁勢上前，追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Chased leaders on jumping from draw 1, gave good response turning home, stormed to the lead nearing 100M winning decisively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，追趕領先馬匹。轉直路彎時對催策反應良佳。接近一百米處時以勁勢取得領先，以漂亮姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Raced wide, on heels of leaders entering home straight, unable to sustain effort, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 早段走外疊。入直路時緊隨領先馬匹。其後無以為繼。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, failed to make any progress thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空，其後未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
