runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders against rail, travelled smoothly into home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時走勢暢順。三百米處轉換跑線以望空，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in 3rd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第三位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Ridden forward from the widest barrier to be 4-wide without cover in midfield, gave ground steadily final bend dropping to last over 200M out.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(5W3W4W) 自最外檔出閘，在催策下上前，居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎逐漸墮退。二百米處墮居包尾位置。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, angled off rail from 500m out, effort top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自五百米處起移離內欄。直路初發力。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Began well, dropped back to a midfield position on settling, ran on fairly passing 400M, not ridden out late sages when awkward placed behind rivals.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘迅速，墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處時走勢一般。末段在對手之後處於窘境之際未能被力策。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Always prominent, just over 2L off the pace into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 一直居前列。入直路時落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Jumped on terms, raced 3-wide no cover in midfield, kept battling final 300M but unable to quicken. Steadied 50M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米持續力拼，但未能加速。五十米處收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider final bend, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (5W3W3W) Held up in mid-division, wide into straight before running on strongly to take lead nearing 100M. Won his 4th race of season with something in hand.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(5W3W3W) 留居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。走勢強勁，接近一百米處時取得領先。取得今季第四場頭馬，勝來猶有餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Chased leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, ran home one paced and was no threat to leaders from mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。保持同速，自直路中段起未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, challenged up rail from 200m out, stayed on but no match for leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時須等待空位出現。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段保持走勢，但不敵領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until 150M, made some progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至一百五十米處，其後略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Awkward start, three wide in rear of mid-field, taken wider on bend, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎移出較外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled towards the rear on the rail, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, closed off nicely, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 500M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (5W2W2W) Travelled wide in prominent positions early after beginning from a wide barrier, obtained one-out-one-back position approaching home bend, gained upper hand 200M out and held on well to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段居前列，走外疊。趨近直路彎時居第二疊第二位。二百米處佔得上風，保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持勁勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from draw 2 to be chasing leader along the fence, weakened quickly passing 300M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第二檔出閘迅速，追趕領放馬，走內欄。跑過三百米處時迅速轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) From widest draw unable to cross runners on its inside and raced very wide without cover in midfield for the majority of the race, fought on steadily final 300M to finish a non-threatening 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 自最外檔出閘，未能超越內側馬匹，大部分途程居中間位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米持續力拼，取得第五名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, effort 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞。跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處發力。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W4W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W4W) Dropped back to a rearward spot after the jump, driven along 500M, closed off steadily down the outside but had too much to make on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W4W) 出閘後墮居後列。五百米處受催策。末段在外疊以穩勢衝刺，但落後領先馬匹太遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, made steady progress under whip, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢良佳。在鞭策下穩步上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 7 lengths or so back, there to turn, made very good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，落後約七個馬位，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W3W) Settled down in second half of the field, closed off final 400M fastest to finish equal 3rd. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 居後半馬群中。最後四百米衝刺最快，取得平頭季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved ground, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。走內欄節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5-1/2L back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered towards rear in 9th on rail, commenced move leaving the 700M reaching within 3L of pace on rail into straight, ran on between runners to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，其後瞬即恢復走勢，居後列第九位，走內欄。跑離七百米處時開始上前。入直路時落後領放馬不逾三個馬位，走內欄。末段在馬匹之間上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly settling just worse than midfield in 9th, made no impression in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間稍後第九位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Pressed leader, bumped and lost balance 300m out, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處發生碰撞，失去平衡。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Soon led, pressed by rival in middle stages, quickened to a clear lead early straight, kept on well just only to be caught near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，中段受一駒追迫。直路早段加速帶離對手，保持佳勢，僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W2W3W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages, unable to hold position final bend, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，中段搶口。直路彎未能保持位置。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made all, kicked three lengths clear 200m out, won unchallenged and going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，一直領放。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。在未受挑戰下拋離對手取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled nicely, kept on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢良佳。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, lay in in the Straight and difficult to ride out (See Incident Report).
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上內閃，難以被力策。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Soon led, controlled race from front, two lengths ahead turning into home straight, responded to pressure from 200m out, unchallenged.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，在領放下主宰步速。轉入直路時領先兩個馬位。自二百米處起對催策交出反應，未受挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on nicely to the line, just won.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持佳勢至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, gave ground slightly passing the 150M, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策以領放。跑過一百五十米處時略為墮退。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon took up running setting a smart pace mid-race, kicked over 1L clear after straightening but unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 70M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，中段以快步速領放。入直路後加速帶離一個馬位，但無以為繼，最後七十米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, unable to quickened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路上未能增速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Clean jump, raced prominently on the inside, travelled well to turn, took the lead early in straight, kept on well but unable to hold off the first few on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 出閘俐落，居前列，走內疊。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路初取得領先。保持佳勢，但過終點時未能抗衡頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact at start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader, hard ridden 400M but only showed limited response, hampered near 250M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬一個半馬位。四百米處受力策，但僅能略為交出反應。接近二百五十米處時受妨礙，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear along the inside, failed to run on in the straight. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路上未能追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Raced in rear, under pressure halfway out to chase leaders, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居後列。半程時受催策，追趕領先馬匹。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Away in line, restrained to a rearward spot 6Ls off the pace, had task ahead top of the straight but was just fair through the line. Never reached contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，在約束下居後列，落後領放馬六個馬位。直路初仍落後頗遠，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。從未有力爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced very wide in mid-field without cover, driven along 500m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W) Dropped back to race in second half of the field, pushed along 550M and brought wide for home, closed off nicely to go 3rd last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 墮居後半馬群中。五百五十米處受推策。入直路時移出外疊。末段衝刺良佳，最後一步跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, ran on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段以勁勢上前，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped on terms, reserved behind midfield along the fence, 4Ls to make up 400M, did best work late to claim 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，留居中間之後位置，走內欄。四百米處落後四個馬位。末段表現最佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, held up last, head in air 700m out, switched wide for clear run 250m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，留居包尾位置。七百米處昂首。二百五十米處移出外疊以望空。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮退。入直路時受推策，走外疊，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear 7Ls back, kept to inside in the straight, closed off well but couldn't be ridden out to the finish final stages when awkwardly placed. Could do better.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後七個馬位。直路上固守內疊。衝刺良佳，但末段處於窘境之際未能被力策至終點。本應可交出更佳表現。
